reviews.pros:
Excellent Work Life Balance.
Complete WFO policy.
reviews.cons:
Think of Groww not much as a startup, but more as an early retirement plan. Here you will enjoy perks of a "Stable" environment- stability in the sense that innovation has been laid to rest in peace, and learning opportunitues have been put on an indefinitr pause.
Here the concept of upward mobility has a unique twist. Promotions are abundant... for the chosen few, especially if you are well-acquainted with those upstairs. The Senior management team thrives on a heartwarming sense of community, promoting from within - within their own circles, After all, who better to entrust with the future of the company than their nearest and dearest?
Its a comfortable place to coast along, savor the benefits, and watch as true engineering innovation fades into the background. Here, you can rest easy, knowing that the primary focus is on accumulating ESOPs rather than solving actual business problems.
If you are looking for exciting and challenging workplace with room to groww... maybe keep looking. But if you are ready to kick and enjoy the cozy vibes of a "good retirement company", this might be the right place for you.

questions.question: What does mean of the sales?
questions.answer: Sales refers to the process of selling goods or services in exchange for money, crucial for business revenue generation.Sales involve identifying customer needs and providing solutions through products or services.Effective sales strategies can include direct selling, online marketing, and relationship building.For example, a car dealership uses sales techniques to match customers with vehicles that fit their needs.Sales metrics, like conversion rates and average deal size, help businesses assess performance.

questions.question: What's customer service?
questions.answer: Customer service is the support and assistance provided to customers before, during, and after purchasing products or services.Responsive communication: Quickly addressing customer inquiries via phone, email, or chat.Personalized assistance: Tailoring support to individual customer needs, like recommending products based on past purchases.Problem resolution: Effectively handling complaints and issues, such as replacing a defective item promptly.Feedback collection: Actively seeking customer opinions to improve services, like conducting surveys after a purchase.Building relationships: Engaging with customers through loyalty programs or follow-up calls to enhance their experience.
